title: No prompt caching on minimax/vibebh harness transports — 1.6M-19.6M uncached input tokens per code task
wanted_capability: Prompt caching (or equivalent context-reuse) on the bro-harness transports that currently resend the full conversation uncached every turn. Measured during the TUI friction campaign (thread-c3f7c7e3): a ~30min minimax code task consumed 19,602,803 uncached input tokens; a ~13min vibebh task 1,651,011 uncached (74k cached). On the same workload shapes, deepseek and brodex cache well (deepseek ~4-11M cached vs ~70-100k fresh; brodex ~7-25M cached vs ~100-280k fresh). If MiniMax's Anthropic-compatible endpoint supports cache_control breakpoints, the harness should send them; if Mistral's chat-completions endpoint has no caching, consider harness-side mitigation (aggressive compaction thresholds, trimming) or surface the economics in the allocator so cost-aware tiering avoids these providers for long agentic tasks.
missing_primitive: cache_control / context-reuse support (or per-provider cache-capability metadata consumed by the allocator) in crates/bro-harness transports for minimax (Anthropic transport — verify whether the endpoint honors cache_control and whether the harness omits it) and vibebh (OpenAI chat-completions transport).
fallback_used: Operator excluded vibebh from campaign dispatch rounds; minimax kept but burns ~20M input tokens per long task.
evidence: live probe 2026-06-11: old shape (ttl:1h, 1 rolling bp, extended-cache-ttl beta) req1 input=1030 cache_read=114; req2 input=14 cache_read=1130
live probe: new shape (plain ephemeral, 2 rolling bp, no cache beta) req1+req2 input=14 cache_read=1130

https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/anthropic-api-compatible-cache: 20-block lookback per breakpoint, max 4 breakpoints (most recent 4), 5-min refresh-on-read lifetime, no ttl/extended-TTL beta
https://platform.minimax.io/docs/api-reference/text-prompt-caching: automatic prefix caching, 512+ input tokens, prefix order tools→system→messages, cache writes free

fix: worktree .claude/worktrees/minimax-cache-mechanics branch feat/minimax-cache-mechanics, crates/bro-harness/src/transport/anthropic.rs (cargo nextest -p bro-harness 218 passed; workspace gate green)
notes:
Re-derived 2026-06-11 against MiniMax's published cache docs (text-prompt-caching + anthropic-api-compatible-cache) on worktree feat/minimax-cache-mechanics. Corrections to the N1 resolution: (1) the "MiniMax ignores breakpoints" conclusion is stale — a live probe (2x2 requests, old vs new wire shape, MiniMax-M3) shows the endpoint now serves cache reads (req2: input=14, cache_read=1130) even with the old shape, consistent with MiniMax's automatic prefix caching (passive, 512+ token minimum, tools→system→messages prefix order); the zero-cache economics measured in the TUI campaign were endpoint-side state that has since changed. (2) Two harness-side deviations from MiniMax's documented explicit mechanics were found and fixed in crates/bro-harness/src/transport/anthropic.rs: cache_control carried ttl:"1h" (Anthropic extended-TTL beta shape; MiniMax documents plain {"type":"ephemeral"} only, 5-min refresh-on-read server-managed lifetime) — now plain when base_url is MiniMax; and the single rolling last-message breakpoint is defeated by the documented ~20-block lookback per breakpoint when a turn appends >20 blocks — now two rolling breakpoints (last two array-content messages), total exactly 4 (MiniMax honors most recent 4). Usage counters were already parsed; MiniMax reports cache_creation=0 (cache writes free/uncounted).

CLOSE-OUT VALIDATION 2026-06-11: the vibebh half is handled by commit 48adf66 (feat(vibebh): enable Mistral prompt cache key) on beta/blackbox-v2 — prompt_cache_key wired from the durable harness session id (stable across turns/resume), gated to the Mistral reasoning profile, usage fold subtracts prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens from fresh input, catalog flipped VibeBh→chat_completions_prompt_cache_key (allocator-visible via bro_providers). Live-validated against api.mistral.ai: prompt_cache_key accepted (no 422 unknown-field rejection — the regression risk with Mistral's strict validation), and a repeated 1.5k-token prefix with stable key served cached=1520/1529 on req2. GLM (docs.z.ai/guides/capabilities/cache) and DeepSeek (api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/kv_cache) doc check: both cache implicitly/automatically (no cache_control mechanism, no documented field strictness); our breakpoints+ttl are tolerated metadata there and campaign data already showed both caching well — the harness's prefix-stable request construction (stable system blocks first, volatile tail, append-only messages) is the only requirement, already satisfied. All four harness Anthropic/chat providers now have a verified caching story. minimax fix rebased onto origin/beta/blackbox-v2 (commit on feat/minimax-cache-mechanics, worktree .claude/worktrees/minimax-cache-mechanics); workspace nextest green (3772 passed). Related threads harness-dispatch-economics (thread-9dfe1da5) and wave7-dispatch-forensics (thread-36f3cced) already resolved; no open economics gaps remain.
resolution_note: Addressed by unit N1 (commit 448b5560, beta/blackbox-v2): investigation found the harness ALREADY sends cache_control breakpoints to minimax (same Anthropic transport path as glm/deepseek; MiniMax-shaped regression test added proving stable-system-block + rolling-last-message breakpoints) — the zero cached tokens are endpoint-side: MiniMax ignores the breakpoints. vibebh's chat-completions transport has no explicit context-reuse handle (documented in transport module docs; OpenAI cached-token wire fields corrected: Responses input_tokens_details.cached_tokens vs chat-completions prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens). Shipped the surfacing half of the wanted capability: PromptCacheCapability metadata in the bro-core provider catalog (glm/deepseek/minimax=anthropic_cache_control, brodex=open_ai_prompt_token_details, vibebh=none_known) exposed via bro_providers as promptCache, so allocator/cost-aware tiering can read it. Allocator behavior changes deliberately out of scope (operator-gated). Residual economics are endpoint-limited, not harness-limited; operator mitigation (vibebh excluded from dispatch waves) stands.
